scripts.bootstrap: python3 -c "import sys; assert sys.version_info >= (3, 11), 'Python 3.11+ is required'" && npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && python3 -m venv --clear backend/.venv && backend/.venv/bin/python -m pip install -r backend/requirements-dev.txt
scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run test
